lifeEvents.description: Destroys the temple and city and carries Judah into exile in Babylon.

lifeEvents.title: Found righteous in a violent generation
lifeEvents.description: Noah walks with God while the earth is filled with violence.

lifeEvents.title: Builds the ark
lifeEvents.description: He does all that God commanded him — exactly.

lifeEvents.title: Rides out the flood
lifeEvents.description: Shut in by God, the family and the animals survive while the waters cover the earth.

lifeEvents.title: Given the rainbow
lifeEvents.description: God sets his bow in the cloud as the sign of a covenant with every living creature.

lifeEvents.title: Marries into Naomi's family, then is widowed
lifeEvents.description: She marries one of Naomi's sons and is left a widow with Ruth and Naomi.

lifeEvents.title: Returns to her own people
lifeEvents.description: She weeps and kisses Naomi goodbye, and goes back to Moab — a choice the text never condemns.

lifeEvents.title: Refuses, plague after plague
lifeEvents.description: Each time a plague lifts, his heart hardens and he refuses to let Israel go.

lifeEvents.title: Finally lets Israel go
lifeEvents.description: After his own son dies in the tenth plague, he tells Moses and Aaron to take Israel and leave.

lifeEvents.title: Pursues Israel to the sea
lifeEvents.description: He changes his mind and chases Israel with his army, which the sea then destroys.

lifeEvents.title: Finds the basket in the reeds
lifeEvents.description: Bathing at the river, she sees the basket, sends a servant for it, and hears the baby crying.

lifeEvents.title: Adopts him as her son
lifeEvents.description: She names him Moses - because I drew him out of the water.

lifeEvents.title: Tests Solomon with hard questions
lifeEvents.description: Travels from Sheba to see if his reported wisdom is real.

lifeEvents.title: Met at the well
lifeEvents.description: Jacob rolls the stone away for her flock and weeps aloud when he kisses her.

lifeEvents.title: Barren while her sister bears sons
lifeEvents.description: Loved but childless, she envies Leah and pleads with Jacob for children.

lifeEvents.title: God remembers her
lifeEvents.description: She bears Joseph, and asks for one more son.

lifeEvents.title: Dies giving birth to Benjamin
lifeEvents.description: She names him son of my sorrow with her last breath; Jacob renames him son of my right hand.

lifeEvents.title: Hides the Israelite spies
lifeEvents.description: She hides them on her roof, believing Yahweh has already given Israel the land, and asks only that her family be spared.

lifeEvents.title: Spared when Jericho falls
lifeEvents.description: She and her family are the only ones in the city who survive.

lifeEvents.title: Waters ten camels for a stranger
lifeEvents.description: Her kindness is the sign Abraham's servant had prayed for.

lifeEvents.title: Agrees to go
lifeEvents.description: Asked whether she will leave with the man, she says simply: I will go.

lifeEvents.title: Told two nations are in her womb
lifeEvents.description: The children struggle inside her; she is told the elder will serve the younger.

lifeEvents.title: Engineers Jacob's blessing
lifeEvents.description: She overhears Isaac's plan and dresses Jacob to take his brother's blessing.

lifeEvents.title: Rejects the elders' counsel
lifeEvents.description: Chooses harshness over his father's more moderate advisers, and loses ten tribes on the spot.

lifeEvents.title: Marries into Naomi's family, then is widowed
lifeEvents.description: She marries one of Naomi's sons; ten years later he is dead along with his father and brother.

lifeEvents.title: Refuses to leave Naomi
lifeEvents.description: "Where you go, I will go... your people will be my people, and your God my God."

lifeEvents.title: Gleans in Boaz's field
lifeEvents.description: She asks to gather leftover grain, and happens into the field of a man who already knows what she has done for Naomi.

lifeEvents.title: Asks Boaz for redemption
lifeEvents.description: At the threshing floor at night, she asks him to spread his garment over her as a near kinsman.

lifeEvents.title: Redeemed and married by Boaz
lifeEvents.description: He takes her as his wife at the town gate, before the elders of the city.

lifeEvents.title: Bears a son, Obed
lifeEvents.description: Her son becomes the grandfather of Jesse, the father of David.

lifeEvents.title: Born a Nazirite
lifeEvents.description: An angel tells his once-childless mother he will begin to deliver Israel.

lifeEvents.title: Falls in love with Delilah
lifeEvents.description: She is paid to discover the secret of his strength.

lifeEvents.title: Betrayed and shorn
lifeEvents.description: Worn down, he finally tells her the truth, and loses his strength while he sleeps.

lifeEvents.title: Pulls down the temple
lifeEvents.description: Blinded and mocked, he prays for strength one last time and brings the building down on everyone in it.

lifeEvents.title: Given to Eli as a small child
lifeEvents.description: His mother Hannah brings him to serve at the tabernacle for life.

lifeEvents.title: Hears Yahweh call his name
lifeEvents.description: He answers, "Speak, for your servant hears."

lifeEvents.title: Anoints Saul as king
lifeEvents.description: He pours oil on Saul's head in private, then presents him to the people.

lifeEvents.title: Tells Saul he is rejected as king
lifeEvents.description: "To obey is better than sacrifice."

lifeEvents.title: Anoints David
lifeEvents.description: He anoints the youngest of Jesse's sons in the middle of his brothers.

lifeEvents.title: Appears to Saul after death
lifeEvents.description: Brought up by a medium, his spirit tells Saul he will die the next day.

lifeEvents.title: Leaves Haran with Abram
lifeEvents.description: She goes with him to a land neither of them has seen.

lifeEvents.title: Gives Hagar to Abram
lifeEvents.description: Childless and out of patience, she tries to build a family another way.

lifeEvents.title: Laughs at the tent door
lifeEvents.description: Told she will have a son within the year, she laughs — and is asked whether anything is too hard for Yahweh.

lifeEvents.title: Bears Isaac at ninety
lifeEvents.description: God has made laughter for her, and everyone who hears will laugh with her.

lifeEvents.title: Dies at Kiriath Arba
lifeEvents.description: Abraham comes to mourn for her and to weep for her.

lifeEvents.title: Chosen as Israel's first king
lifeEvents.description: From the smallest family in the smallest tribe, anointed and then acclaimed by all the people.

lifeEvents.title: Rejected as king
lifeEvents.description: Two acts of disobedience cost him the dynasty God would otherwise have established.

lifeEvents.title: Hunts David for years
lifeEvents.description: Jealous and increasingly desperate, he pursues the man he knows will replace him.

lifeEvents.title: Consults a medium at Endor
lifeEvents.description: With God silent, he breaks his own law banning mediums to ask one for help.

lifeEvents.title: Dies on Mount Gilboa
lifeEvents.description: Badly wounded and refusing capture, he falls on his own sword.

lifeEvents.title: His army struck down outside Jerusalem
lifeEvents.description: 185,000 dead in a night; he withdraws to Nineveh.

lifeEvents.title: Given a son, and gets him back from death
lifeEvents.description: Builds Elisha a room, is promised a child, and later rides to fetch the prophet when the boy dies.

lifeEvents.title: Commands the army oppressing Israel
lifeEvents.description: For twenty years his nine hundred iron chariots keep Israel under Canaanite rule.

lifeEvents.title: Killed in his sleep by Jael
lifeEvents.description: He flees to what he thinks is a safe tent, and never wakes up.

lifeEvents.title: Becomes king
lifeEvents.description: Anointed by Zadok the priest while Adonijah is still trying to claim the throne.

lifeEvents.title: Asks for wisdom instead of riches
lifeEvents.description: Given a free choice by God, asks for an understanding heart to govern well.

lifeEvents.title: Judges between two mothers
lifeEvents.description: Exposes the real mother by ordering the child divided in two.

lifeEvents.title: Builds and dedicates the temple
lifeEvents.description: God's glory fills the finished temple as a cloud.

lifeEvents.title: Receives the queen of Sheba
lifeEvents.description: Answers all her hard questions; she says not half of his fame had been told her.

lifeEvents.title: His heart turns after other gods
lifeEvents.description: His many foreign wives draw him into idolatry in his old age; God tells him the kingdom will be torn away.

lifeEvents.title: Raped by Amnon
lifeEvents.description: Her half-brother forces her, then throws her out and hates her afterward.

lifeEvents.title: Sent to die in battle
lifeEvents.description: Refuses to go home to his wife while his fellow soldiers are camped in the field, so David has Joab place him where the fighting is fiercest.

lifeEvents.title: Prospers while he seeks God
lifeEvents.description: As long as he sought Yahweh, God made him prosper, and his fame spread far.

lifeEvents.title: Struck with leprosy for his pride
lifeEvents.description: Enters the temple to burn incense, rages at the priests who stop him, and is a leper from that hour.

lifeEvents.title: Her flour and oil never run out
lifeEvents.description: Shares her last meal with Elijah first, and her jar never empties through the famine; later her son is revived after dying.

lifeEvents.title: Rebukes Joash, and is killed for it
lifeEvents.description: "Because you have forsaken Yahweh, he has also forsaken you." He is stoned in the temple court; his last words: "May Yahweh see, and avenge."

lifeEvents.title: The last king of Judah, blinded and exiled
lifeEvents.description: Sees his sons killed, then is blinded and taken to Babylon in chains.

lifeEvents.title: Met at a well in Midian
lifeEvents.description: Moses defends her and her sisters from shepherds driving them off, and waters their flock.

lifeEvents.title: Given to Moses in marriage
lifeEvents.description: Her father gives her to Moses, content that he should dwell with them.

lifeEvents.title: Bears a son, Gershom
lifeEvents.description: Moses names him Gershom - for he said, I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land.
